core_obligations: Construct the degree one map (proof lines 522-534): compose the maps from the differentials of the source to the relative differentials, then to the module of the relation, then to the differentials of the base, the middle one being the previously constructed trace map.

Compute the cokernel of the connecting map (proof lines 534-548): the transitivity exact sequence places the cokernel of the connecting map as the first step; the relative differentials are free on the differential of the generator, the first homology of the cotangent complex is free on the relation, and the connecting map sends the latter to the class of the differential of the coefficient, so the cokernel is the tensor product of the source with the quotient of the differentials of the base by the submodule generated by that differential.

Build the trace on higher forms (proof lines 548-564): there is a canonical map from the top exterior power of the differentials of the source to the tensor product of the exterior power of the computed cokernel with the relative differentials; since the image of the degree one trace map is contained in the submodule generated by the differential of the relation, wedging with an element of that image annihilates that differential, so the map factors through a canonical map to the top exterior power of the differentials of the base with the displayed formula.
proof_roadmap: Compose the relative and absolute differential maps to get the degree one trace map.
Use the transitivity exact sequence to compute the cokernel of the connecting map.
Take exterior powers and use the image description to produce the higher trace maps with the stated formula.
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs canonical trace maps from the top exterior power of the differentials of the source to the top exterior power of the differentials of the base for an extension presented by a p-th power relation, with the explicit formula on wedges of the generator and with the maps annihilating the image of the extended differentials of the base (statement lines 500-521). The proof (proof lines 522-564) builds the degree one map, computes the cokernel of the connecting map of the transitivity sequence, and obtains the higher maps by an exterior algebra construction. H3: an explicit computation with the transitivity sequence and an exterior power argument, written out in full.
